title: Reporting Rates Module
text: module offers two metrics quantifying adverse-event reporting behaviour time: Cumulative rate per total exposure time: continuous cumulative measure adverse events relative total accumulated subject‑time. crptt(t)=∑=1NAEi(t)∑=1NTi(t)\text{crptt}(t) = \frac{\sum_{=1}^N AE_i(t)}{\sum_{=1}^N T_i(t)} , AEi(t) represents number adverse events reported subject study start day t, Ti(t) corresponding total observation time subject . module shows rate line plot. Reporting rate per active patients: interval‑based measure events per actively observed patients (weekly monthly).rrpap(,b)=∑=1NAEi(,b)∑=1NIi(b)\text{rrpap}(, b) = \frac{\sum_{=1}^N AE_i(,b)}{\sum_{=1}^N I_i(b)} , AEi(, b) number events reported subject interval, Ii(b) indicates whether subject still observed day b. Users may choose weekly monthly intervals. module shows rate step plot.
